item.title: 🔵 When Credentials Are No Longer Enough: Device Trust in the AI Era
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

Specops explains why organizations are increasingly adding device trust to their Zero Trust strategies. [...]
